concept.verdict: Grey round chamber, green foot/side risers, red details and stepped terminal agree with legacy. Concept lengthens the foot, thickens service pods and rearranges the asymmetric lower panel; reject those changes and retain source-guided proportions and detail placement.

feedback: Actual independent GLB retains legacy grey round upper chamber, narrow equipment drum, green flared foot, curved green side risers/red details, asymmetric front strips/panel, round fittings and segmented terminal.

Six protected mapped profile parts retain exact evaluated geometry, six measurable dents, full colour/roughness pixels and twelve planar-cap surfaces. Curved risers follow the chamber skin and retain the prior local/deformed UV mapping and contact checks.

Concept lengthens foot, thickens side pods and rearranges panel details. These departures are rejected. Existing wear is subtler; exact rear/underside, spherical interpretation, seam and fitting engineering remain inferred.
Catalogue phases reveal/highlight a fixed object, not a mechanical cycle. Current selector does not list ID052 as directional; RIS2 construction remains separate.

96,640 triangles, 34 physical components, eight materials and eight embedded maps are a substantial asset cost. No Android FPS, batching, game scale/state integration or final user artistic acceptance is certified.
